elements_selected.content: Implement the ratatui Layout that divides the terminal into three columns: main pane (default 58% of terminal width, configurable via --main-width), bridge column (exactly 3 characters wide), and context pane (remaining width). Add a status bar row pinned to the bottom (1 row). When terminal width < 60 columns, switch to single-pane mode (main pane only; context overlay is a separate task). Store computed pane rects in ViewApp for use by all rendering tasks. REQ-063, NFR-025.
